requirements.detail: The committed R6 candidate, pinned base, current branch ancestry, and unchanged canonical app tree were verified.
A fresh isolated replay applied R3, R5, and R6 in order; 53/53 R3, 32/32 R5, and 35/35 R6 manifest outputs verified without extras or omissions.
The R6 patch contains only AssetLoader.ts and completion-essential-loader.test.ts; both replacements match candidate bytes and hashes.
The failed R5 state was independently reproduced as a red test; the exact R6 code makes the current-attempt aggregate determinate after retry.
Retained regression cases keep compressed, unknown, absent, contradictory, chunked, and EOF-mismatched current representations indeterminate.
The built candidate UI recovered from the compressed room failure; the final aggregate was 1,758,012/1,758,012 from the three current identity attempts, excluding the failed four bytes.
The candidate runtime material module and real Three.js objects restore visible/shared state, registries, maps, and derivative disposal after controlled second-target failure.
The candidate WorldRuntime rejects stale callbacks after greeting replacement and rejects a captured callback after route unmount using browser timer behavior.
Focused suite: 56 tests; full unit: 356 tests across 26 files; integration: 290 tests across 28 files.
Offline frozen-lockfile installation, lint, typecheck, independent production build, and source-bound Chromium run passed; browser run was 3/3.
The historical R5 command was not reconstructed or run, as required by FINISH-09.
The review was performed locally by Codex; no external GPT Plus #2 review is claimed.
These production and G7 checks are outside FINISH-11 audit scope.
This audit does not authorize or perform canonical integration.
